Priya (Design): New thread: proposal to add a Burst scheduling window and tighter keyboard flows for the autoscale row. Sketches in FigJam. Main problems: burst toggle disappears when rows collapse, color for burst badge fails contrast in dark mode, keyboard users can't set schedule windows easily, and SLO fine-tune is hard without numeric input. Thoughts?
Noah (Frontend): I can add a small chevron the row to expand scheduling controls but that will change row height when expanded. For collapsed state I can show a condensed burst badge that opens a popover. Keyboard-wise, popovers must be reachable with Enter/Space and tabbable inside.
Ava (A11Y): Accessibility must be first-class. Burst badge needs 4.5:1 contrast in both light/dark themes; don't rely on color alone. For the popover ensure focus trap and return focus to the badge. For the SLO slider, provide a visible numeric input that appears on Enter on the slider, with aria-label "SLO target milliseconds". Use aria-live to announce schedule window set.
Sam (PM): Product constraints: burst scheduling should default off. When users enable a schedule window, show clear billing callout: "Burst scheduled between 08:00-10:00 local time. Billed while active." Also add a guardrail if scheduled window >6 hours: show cost warning. Do not auto-disable burst.
Jae (Eng): Backend notes: we'll extend the API with burst_window {start_iso, end_iso} optional. Need to validate timezone handling and cap at pool.max_gpus. For analytics, emit burst_schedule_set and burst_schedule_override events. Also ensure backward compatibility if client doesn't send window.
Marco (SRE): From infra side, scheduled bursts will map to autoscaler hints. We should rate-limit schedule changes to avoid oscillation. Also warn that scheduled bursts may not be available if capacity constrained.
Priya (Design): Microcopy: label "Burst schedule"; tooltip "Set a recurring window for temporary extra GPUs (billed while active)." For collapsed badge copy use "Burst: Off" or "Burst: 1h scheduled". For cost guardrail: "Scheduled burst >6h may increase monthly cost  view estimate".
Noah (Frontend): Implementation: condensed badge opens a keyboard-accessible popover. Inside: start/end timepickers (24h), a duration summary, and a numeric SLO input. Add role="dialog" aria-modal="true" and aria-labelledby. Use DOM order: pool picker -> burst badge -> SLO slider -> min/max.
Ava (A11Y): Ensure the timepickers are keyboard-friendly (arrow keys adjust, manual input allowed). Announce changes with aria-live polite: "Burst scheduled 08:00 to 10:00". Provide an off-screen help text that explains billing.
Sam (PM): UX decision: show cost-estimate link in the popover instead of inline to reduce noise. Guardrail threshold at 6 hours. Use softer language: "This scheduled burst may increase monthly cost  view estimate."
Jae (Eng): We'll add server-side validation for window length and emit a warning flag when window >6h. Debounce client saves to 800ms and feature-flag behind autoscale-schedule.
Priya (Design): I'll update mocks: condensed badge for collapsed rows, popover with keyboard-first controls, higher-contrast badge colors, visible focus states, and the numeric SLO input on Enter. Will add a11y notes in the spec.
Noah (Frontend): I'll build the popover prototype and wire to the API behind flag. Plan to ship to staging for a11y review.
deploy-bot: deploy/ui-staging v2.48.0 succeeded  https://staging.redwood.dev/deploys/4597
Priya (Design): Thanks team  I'll run a 5-min keyboard test once staging flag is live. :sparkles:
